claims.sentence: Participants will be asked to: * Take the dietary supplement daily for 4 weeks * Attend two study visits to have their blood vessels checked, answer questionnaires, and give a sample of blood Researchers will compare people who took the dietary supplement with others who took a placebo to see if the blood flow in the blood vessels improved.
